notes: Recorded 17 undergraduate programmes plus 20 specializations/majors stated inside them (37 rows) for the bachelor level; the 2026-2027 catalogue table of contents lists exactly these 17 undergraduate programmes (4 BCB, 5 CSS, 2 Law School, 4 CHSE, 2 SCSM).

Rows with a colon are specializations or majors the catalogue lists inside the programme (BACTA, BFIN, BMGT, BMKT specializations; BAE, BIR, BPMA, BAJ majors); programmes without such rows state none in the parts read.

The grant page does not say the grant covers every programme; it states no programme restriction either. Programmes are therefore the KIMEP undergraduate catalogue, not a grant-specific list. any_subject is left unset.
Grant page text read in the Kazakh-language version; the English-language grant page was not separately compared.
not_stated: Whether the grant is limited to particular undergraduate programmes: the grant page names none.
